affectedPublicSurfaces: THE CONFIRMATION PAYLOAD — the surface this slice actually changes, and the one a seller reads before consenting. Approving a Clear Excess card now runs the CLEAR EXCESS playbook instead of Optimize Product's, and the confirmation sheet renders a DISCOUNT PROPOSAL rather than a listing or price edit. The payload carries the single proposal, its computed parameters, its three disclosure lines and the restated stock goal, and it is PARAMS-HASH BOUND (ADR-075) so 'exactly the computed parameters' is checkable rather than asserted. A client rendering a confirmation for `clear_excess_4` will see a proposal shape it has never seen.

THE PLAYBOOK REGISTRY GOES FROM ONE ENTRY TO TWO. Verified 2026-09-08: `services/agent/playbooks/` holds `__init__.py`, `base.py` and `optimize_product.py` and NOTHING ELSE; `playbooks/__init__.py:50-63` `get_registered_playbooks()` returns exactly one entry and the module docstring (`:4-5`) says so — 'the only playbook registered in this repo today'. `services/agent/prompts/` holds `__init__.py`, `composer.py` and `optimize_product/{v1,v2,v3}.md`; only one workflow has prompts. This is the first time the registry resolves a SECOND workflow, so every place that implicitly assumed one is now load-bearing.

THE TOOL ALLOWLIST IS WHERE ADR-091 d.4's DELETION IS ENFORCED. NO base-price write and NO stock write appear in this workflow's allowlist — that is not a coding preference, it is the mechanism by which `execution_layer.md` §4 step 6a is actually deleted rather than merely documented as deleted. The set is exactly two: `create_product_discount` (reused from #1778, UNCHANGED) and `deactivate_activity` (a WRITE tool over the captured sandbox endpoint from #1717). Nothing else.

THE THREE HANDLER DICTS — with a correction the issue body gets wrong. The issue says the three literal handler dicts live 'in `runner/tool_executor.py`'. Verified 2026-09-08 they are DECLARED ELSEWHERE and only imported and dispatched there: `services/agent/tools/terminal.py:99` `TERMINAL_TOOL_HANDLERS`, `tools/product.py:512` `PRODUCT_READ_TOOL_HANDLERS`, `tools/product_write.py:423` `PRODUCT_WRITE_TOOL_HANDLERS`; `runner/tool_executor.py` imports them at `:119,:123,:127` and dispatches at `:273-276` and `:305-309`. Registration therefore goes through #1704's domain-registered dispatcher, and the executor must edit the declaring modules, not the dispatcher.

A TRACKED, SELLER-EDITABLE THANH LÝ CHECKLIST ITEM ON THE RUN (#1713, S-FR-12) — a seller-visible item with editable text and a tick time in the ledger, which GATES NO STAGE in v1. Its copy must say PLAINLY that Juli can neither apply nor verify the clearance label: TikTok has no Partner API surface for it, it cannot be applied at 0 stock, and adding stock silently strips it. Copy that implies Juli will do it is a false promise on a surface the seller acts on.

NO NEW HTTP ROUTE. The registry gains an entry, the prompt gains a binding, the allowlist gains two tools and the run gains a checklist item; no endpoint is added and no existing response model changes shape.

htmlRoutes: No HTML route, page, bundle or static asset changes. The diff is a new playbook under `services/agent/playbooks/`, a prompt binding under `services/agent/prompts/`, the tool spec and handler entry for `deactivate_activity` in the declaring module under `services/agent/tools/`, the registry wiring through #1704's dispatcher, the checklist item on the run, and tests. migrationCompatibility.notes: NO SCHEMA CHANGE. The playbook, the prompt binding, the tool specs and the allowlist are all code; the tracked checklist item rides #1713's already-landed checklist shape and this slice adds no column of its own. Old and new code coexist trivially: the previous release resolves only the Optimize Product playbook and never names the Clear Excess key. TWO CONDITIONAL RESERVATIONS, stated so they are not decided quietly. (1) If the discount create must PERSIST THE ACTIVITY ID Juli created in a new column — the durable record rule 5's collision check and #1817's creation snapshot both depend on, and the only collision input there will ever be, since `Search Activities` does not exist at TikTok — that column's number is RESERVED BY META and supplied with the issue. (2) If #1713's checklist shape turns out not to be landed, STOP AND REPORT rather than inventing a checklist table here. In either case: NEVER run `alembic heads`, never read the tip of `backend/src/juli_backend/database/migrations/versions/`, never derive the number from the newest filename. The chain's single head today is `055_juli_app_sync_state_update`, but W6, W8, W9 and the sibling W10 lanes hold unlanded numbers off-tree and this tree already carries two duplicate-numbered pairs (`003_*`, `043_*`) from exactly this mistake.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge. The registry keeps its single Optimize Product entry, `services/agent/prompts/` keeps its one binding, no `deactivate_activity` tool exists, and approving a Clear Excess card keeps doing whatever it does today. #1816, #1817 and #1818 stay blocked on a playbook that does not exist, which is where they are now. Nothing is exposed, nothing is partially applied, no vendor write ever occurred, and no data hazard exists.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: REVERT THE REGISTRY ENTRY, then redeploy the previous release and restart juli-api and juli-celery-worker. Runs ALREADY CREATED keep their workflow key and their RECORDED allowlist, so a run's history stays readable and auditable after the revert; what they lose is a resolvable playbook, so any run still in flight must be drained or terminated deliberately rather than left to fail on resolution. NO SCHEMA CHANGE means no downgrade — unless the conditional activity-id column was migrated, in which case the previous release simply never names it and needs no downgrade either. THE CONSEQUENCE TO STATE IN THE PR: any Product Discount ALREADY CREATED on a vendor by a Clear Excess run SURVIVES THE REVERT — reverting Juli's code does not deactivate a live TikTok activity, and with the `deactivate_activity` tool gone Juli can no longer end it; those activities must be ended by hand or by re-deploying forward. If #1816 has ALREADY landed when this is rolled back, DRAIN OR REAP EVERY RUN IN `waiting_external` BEFORE reverting: a rollback that removes the resume path strands a suspended run with nothing that recognises its state, and the previous reaper will not reap it.
